annotations.title: Remove a file from a document

description: Removes one attached file from a document. Downloads stop at once, even from a page a reader already has open; the file leaves the page's list the next time the page loads. Copies a reader already downloaded stay with them. It removes the file only: the page, its links and its reading history are untouched, and there is no tool that deletes a page or a link. The file cannot be recovered from HTMLRadar; attaching it again needs the original file. list_attachments returns the attachment id.

document_id.description: The document the file is attached to: from list_documents or list_shares.

name: remove_attachment
